objective: Evaluate the effectiveness of the Nucleus microchannel array in reducing thermal spread and power density at the treatment site
procedure: Prepare the Nucleus microchannel array and the current state-of-the-art electrode
Set the treatment duration to 5 minutes and the coolant fluid flow rate to 10 mL/min
Measure the temperature at the treatment site using a thermocouple
Repeat steps 2-3 for a total of 10 trials
expected_result: A 15% decrease in temperature at the treatment site compared to the current state-of-the-art electrode
falsification_condition: No significant decrease in temperature at the treatment site, or an increase in temperature above 40°C
sample_requirements: 10 trials with 5 minutes treatment duration and 10 mL/min coolant fluid flow rate
safety_constraints: Ensure proper electrical insulation and coolant fluid handling to prevent electrical shock or fluid spills
estimated_duration: 6 weeks (including setup, data collection, and analysis)
information_gain: Understanding the effectiveness of the Nucleus microchannel array in reducing thermal spread and power density at the treatment site, and identifying potential areas for improvement
